title: Function Health pill button
description: A 50px pill in semibold 16px: solid terracotta, outlined terracotta on beige, or a cream pill for use on photos. Colours swap over 0.2s on hover (outline and cream fill in, solid turns midnight).
notes: light variant assumes a dark photo behind it; pass size sm for the 44px version used in forms
name: functionhealth-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description: solid: brand fill · outline: brand hairline on the page colour · light: page-coloured pill with brand text (for photos)

props.name: type
props.description: button type when no href is given
